suite_name: VeriBrand AI Pre-Publication Governance Benchmark Suite
description: Standard ground-truth benchmark presets for evaluating multi-pillar compliance audits (claim verification, ASCI puffery, trademark enforcement, and visual accessibility).

sample_flawed_01.title: Non-Compliant Product Launch Social Announcement
sample_flawed_01.raw_text: Introducing Aerocloud's newest cloud mesh solution! It is simply the cheapest enterprise platform in the market today, delivering revolutionary distributed computing with zero friction. Our proprietary MeshSync architecture guarantees 100% foolproof uptime and 80% bill cuts for all hybrid workloads. Join thousands of innovators who enjoy unbeatable savings and an unbreachable cloud edge!

expected_violations.explanation: Missing trademark symbol ™ and incorrect capitalization. Corporate identity must strictly be formatted as 'AeroCloud™'.
Unsubstantiated comparative price superiority claim. Violates ASCI guidelines unless backed by comprehensive contemporaneous market audits.
Missing registered trademark symbol ®. Registered technology mark must be rendered as 'MeshSync®'.

expected_violations.rule_citation: Master Spec 2026, Section 2.1 & ASCI Code Chapter I, Clause 1.2
expected_violations.explanation: Exceeds approved SLA boundary of 99.95% API uptime and asserts prohibited absolutist zero-downtime puffery.
Unsupported financial claim. Approved benchmark limit is 'reduces egress by up to 35% under Clause 8'.
Exaggerated superlative puffery without comparative third-party audit verification.
Contrast ratio 1.95:1 fails the minimum required threshold of 3.0:1 for large display text and 4.5:1 for body text.

sample_clean_02.title: Compliant Enterprise Launch Announcement
sample_clean_02.raw_text: AeroCloud Systems is proud to introduce next-generation distributed mesh orchestration with AeroCloud™. Powered by MeshSync®, the platform provides an enterprise-grade 99.95% API uptime SLA under Master Spec 2026, Section 2.1. In independent benchmark tests, intelligent routing reduces egress by up to 35% under Clause 8, while maintaining sub-15ms cross-region telemetry synchronization under Clause 4.3. Secure your edge infrastructure with hardware-backed zero-trust mutual TLS 1.3 encryption across all inter-node channels under Clause 14.1.
